summary: Backend-only verification of 4 RDP lifecycle bug fixes (processExpiries paid-until guard + vanished-droplet reconciler, PM2 log redaction, DO-RDP routing in deleteVPSinstance, grace destroy backoff). Ran all 6 listed node test suites against local MongoDB with stubbed axios; 223/223 assertions passed. Code review of _dropletGone, reconcileVanished, instanceIdOf, deleteVPSinstance DO-RDP branch, and redactSecrets confirms all edge cases (404-then-200, non-404 errors, suspended+live droplet, missing DO token, legacy rows w/o lastDeleteAttemptAt, calendar-month end_time winning over 30-day expires_at) are handled.
critical_code_review_comments: _dropletGone correctly treats any non-404 (incl. network errors without .status) as 'alive' thanks to `!e || e.status !== 404` — no false destroys on transient 5xx/429/ECONNRESET.

reconcileVanished includes 'suspended' in its filter, which is correct: live droplet GET→200 means the record is left untouched; vanished→two 404s before marking destroyed (double-check timing via T.goneRecheckMs).
Sweep-1 guard (plan.end_time > now → sync expires_at, no power_off) correctly resolves bug (a) where 30-day expires_at expired ~24h before the calendar-month end_time the bot displays.

deleteVPSinstance now derives contaboId = contaboInstanceId || instanceId || vpsId AND, for provider='digitalocean-rdp', prefixes 'rdp-' when missing — eliminates the reseller-API bare-uuid → Vultr DELETE 401 loop (bug d).

Grace destroy backoff: ≥10 failures within 6h skips the call AND writes nothing/alerts nothing; legacy rows without lastDeleteAttemptAt get exactly one attempt then back off — prevents the 582-attempt loop.

redactSecrets scoped to lines carrying credential labels only (multi-lang incl. 密码/पासवर्ड/PIN/SIP Pass/api key/secret), leaves IP/Username/menu text intact; installConsoleRedaction covers console.* string args so send() 'reply: …' log line is now safe.
seed_data_creation: None — tests use ephemeral local MongoDB docs and in-process axios stub.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 RDP lifecycle bug fixes (iteration 94) verified. Existing suite in test_rdp_lifecycle_fixes_2026-10.js already covers: 404-twice-marked-gone, DO 500 → stays active, GET-checked-twice, live-droplet-untouched, provisioning-row-ignored, admin alert content, reseller mirror, Sweep-1 paid-until guard. No regression on Contabo/Vultr/OVH/DO-Linux routing (test_delete_vps_verify + partC confirm). No new tests needed.
